newsitem.title: USA: Cardinal Health in pact with Buttrey.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal Health in pact with Buttrey.

text.p: Cardinal Health Inc said Wednesday it has entered into a five-year agreement to supply Buttrey Food and Drug Stores Co with pharmaceuticals and related products.
The value of the products to be distributed to Buttrey's 30 pharmacies and mail order facility is about $160 million over the life of the contract.
As part of the agreement, Buttrey will convert all of its store-based pharmacy management systems to Cardinal's Renlar RxDP software, the company said.
In addition, Buttrey has agreed to participate in Cardinal's newly introduced ScriptLINE service, a centralized prescription transaction management and data warehouse application.
Buttrey Food and Drug Stores Co operates supermarkets and a mail-order pharmacy in the Intermountain Region of Montana, Wyoming and North Dakota.
Cardinal Health Inc, a pharmaceutical service provider, serves customers nationwide.
